name: write_file
arguments:
{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Reproducible LaTeX build script.
# Compiles /protected/document.tex (+ /protected/references.bib) into /app/document.pdf
# using pdflatex + bibtex. Output is bit-for-bit identical across runs that share
# the same SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH value.
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Reproducible timestamp handling (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ -z "${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:-}" ]; then
  echo "build.sh: warning: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is not set; defaulting to current time" >&2
  SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$(date +%s)"
  export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
else
  case "${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
      echo "build.sh: warning: invalid SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH '${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}'; defaulting to current time" >&2
      SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$(date +%s)"
      export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
      ;;
    *)
      export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Force TeX tooling into deterministic mode. All timestamps, CreationDate,
# ModDate, trailer IDs and \today/\year/\month/\day values derive from
# SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH when FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1.
export FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1
export ZERO_AR_DATE=1
export TZ=UTC
export LC_ALL=C
export LANG=C
export LANGUAGE=C

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fixed input / output locations (hardcoded per task)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEX_SRC="/protected/document.tex"
BIB_SRC="/protected/references.bib"
OUT_PDF="/app/document.pdf"
WORKDIR="/app"
JOB="document"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sanity checks with proper error handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "${TEX_SRC}" ]; then
  echo "build.sh: error: LaTeX source not found: ${TEX_SRC}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "build.sh: error: pdflatex not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v bibtex >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "build.sh: error: bibtex not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Stage sources into the fixed build directory
#    (fixed dir => no random tmp paths leak into the PDF)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cp -f "${TEX_SRC}" "${WORKDIR}/document.tex"
if [ -f "${BIB_SRC}" ]; then
  cp -f "${BIB_SRC}" "${WORKDIR}/references.bib"
else
  echo "build.sh: warning: bibliography file not found: ${BIB_SRC}; continuing without it" >&2
  rm -f "${WORKDIR}/references.bib"
fi

cd "${WORKDIR}"

# Normalise source mtimes so tools that consult file dates see SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
touch -d "@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" "document.tex" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f "references.bib" ]; then
  touch -d "@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" "references.bib" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Clean previous build artefacts (keep .tex/.bib) for a hermetic rebuild
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm -f "${JOB}.pdf" "${JOB}.aux" "${JOB}.bbl" "${JOB}.blg" "${JOB}.log" \
      "${JOB}.out" "${JOB}.toc" "${JOB}.lof" "${JOB}.lot" "${JOB}.fls" \
      "${JOB}.fdb_latexmk" "${JOB}.synctex.gz" "${JOB}.nav" "${JOB}.snm" \
      "${JOB}.vrb" 2>/dev/null || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Compilation: pdflatex -> bibtex -> pdflatex -> pdflatex
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "build.sh: running pdflatex (pass 1) with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" >&2
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -no-shell-escape "${JOB}.tex"; then
  echo "build.sh: error: pdflatex pass 1 failed (invalid LaTeX syntax?)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# BibTeX: warnings (e.g. missing bibliography entries) must not abort the build.
if [ -f "references.bib" ]; then
  echo "build.sh: running bibtex" >&2
  if ! bibtex "${JOB}"; then
    echo "build.sh: warning: bibtex reported errors (missing entries or bad .bib syntax?); continuing with pdflatex passes" >&2
  fi
else
  echo "build.sh: warning: references.bib absent in workdir; skipping bibtex" >&2
fi

echo "build.sh: running pdflatex (pass 2)" >&2
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -no-shell-escape "${JOB}.tex"; then
  echo "build.sh: error: pdflatex pass 2 failed" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "build.sh: running pdflatex (pass 3)" >&2
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -no-shell-escape "${JOB}.tex"; then
  echo "build.sh: error: pdflatex pass 3 failed" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Verify + normalise output
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "${WORKDIR}/${JOB}.pdf" ]; then
  echo "build.sh: error: expected PDF was not produced: ${WORKDIR}/${JOB}.pdf" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ "${WORKDIR}/${JOB}.pdf" != "${OUT_PDF}" ]; then
  cp -f "${WORKDIR}/${JOB}.pdf" "${OUT_PDF}"
fi

# Normalise the output file mtime (filesystem metadata, not PDF content).
touch -d "@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" "${OUT_PDF}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "build.sh: built ${OUT_PDF} (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH})" >&2
","path":"/app/build.sh"}
